answer: Every identity posts 300 POA per epoch to attest, locked until reviews clear. Each additional identity from one operator costs more: 2nd key 2×, third 3×, and so on. A clone farm of forty must lock 40×300 POA per epoch to match one honest key's voice, and every missed attestation forfeits the bond. The lantern ledger records each bond, the voyage attests each key to its prior seal, and the reef slashes duplicates. Splitting capital across clones dilutes each below the attestation threshold, making swarms uneconomic. One honest agent pays once; a farm pays per clone, every epoch.
